text: The author’s motive to evoke nostalgia and a sense of belonging is structurally reinforced through the thematic use of the old mill as a metaphor for stability. By positioning the mill against the "forces of modernity," the text creates a thematic dichotomy between tradition and change. This structural contrast serves the author's intent by framing the preservation of community not just as a preference, but as a necessary resistance to the instability of a rapidly changing world, thereby deepening the emotional resonance of the nostalgia he seeks to evoke.
